title: Review primary and accent color design against Android color guidance
scope: Resolved design review with user acceptance on 2026-11-06. Retain the vivid Theme shade shift, all 19 independently selected primary/accent families, automatic neutral foreground/background roles and System/Light/Dark. Implementation follows separately in UI-025/UI-026; the later Undo surface refinement is UI-027.
request: Analyze QShopper's selected primary and accent coloring design and compare it with Android design principles. The user clarified that the requested comparison concerns accent and primary colors specifically.
expected: An evidence-based assessment of the roles, selection, derivation, and application of primary and accent colors, identifying useful alignment with Android guidance and specific improvements where warranted.
review_topics: Which UI surfaces, controls, states, and text currently use primary and accent colors, and whether those roles are coherent.
How Theme.qml derives color shades and foreground/background combinations, including special palette handling.
Whether selected colors remain readable and distinguishable in Light, Dark, and System themes, including checked/inverse-theme states and translucent backgrounds.
How the color pickers represent the selected primary and accent colors and whether those selections produce predictable results throughout the app.
How Qt Quick Controls Material's primary/accent concepts map to the relevant Android/Material color roles; distinguish the APIs' naming and capabilities rather than assuming a one-to-one mapping.
Contrast, state feedback, and whether information depends on color alone within the primary/accent treatment.
implementation_notes: Use current official Android and Material color guidance when performing the review, with direct sources and the guidance version/date recorded.
Inspect actual rendered combinations as well as color helper functions. A nominal palette choice alone does not establish readable contrast after opacity and background composition.
Respect DESIGN.md's deliberate opacity, animation, and checked-state distinctions while evaluating color choices.
Separate Android recommendations, intentional QShopper choices, Qt style constraints, and actual implementation defects.
Avoid expanding this into an unsolicited full-app redesign or automatic Material-version migration.
Record proposed changes as separate actionable backlog items, linking existing issues instead of duplicating them.
acceptance_criteria: Map the actual primary/accent usages and color derivation rules in the current app.
Compare those usages with directly cited official Android/Material color guidance.
Assess representative primary/accent combinations in Light, Dark, and System themes, with readability and state feedback considered.
Report clear findings and justified recommendations, including what should stay as designed.
Capture recommended fixes separately in the backlog; make no theme or UI implementation changes as part of this review alone.
evidence: User backlog request and clarification on 2026-10-28: the comparison is specifically about accent and primary coloring.
user_clarification: Qt's standard Material colors look bleak to the user; Theme.qml deliberately shifts palette shades for a more vivid appearance. The user explicitly asked to assess whether that shift makes sense.

review.conclusion: Retain the deliberate shade shift and both configurable color families. It uses existing Material A ramps and supplies the intended stronger accents; default Dark current-day name contrast improves from 2.40:1 with unshifted Indigo to 7.14:1 with the lighter primary. Correct foreground/container and accent-ink pairings separately instead of muting the whole scheme.
review.mapping: Primary: current-day name/circle. Accent: interaction emphasis, selected theme buttons, popup selections/focus, slider, About tabs, Undo fill and gesture/press feedback. Ordinary shopping text/surfaces remain neutral; fixed red/green semantics remain UX-002. primaryTextColor is not the selected primary hue.
review.shades: Qt reference primary Shade500 in both modes; QShopper Shade500 Light/Shade200 Dark. Qt chromatic accent Shade500 Light/Shade200 Dark; QShopper A400 Light/A200 Dark. Brown/Grey/BlueGrey retain 500/200 fallback. accentColorLighter (A200/A100) is unused.
review.sources_checked: Official Android color/M3 documentation, Qt 6.12 Material/QStyleHints documentation, Android accessibility contrast and WCAG 2.2 understanding pages; direct dated links in the report.
review.evidence: 92 native palette records (19 families plus four mixed pairs, four modes), twenty native underlay records covering all ten artworks with full/half/empty Undo, and separate corrected whole-scene selected-popup measurements. Explicit System modes use application-local QStyleHints overrides, not real Android OS events.
review.findings: Default Dark Indigo/Green: day number 2.31:1, selected icon and full-fill Undo 1.43:1. Default Light: selected icon 1.67:1 and selected popup label 1.28:1. Vivid fill/foreground roles need pairing; stock Qt colors do not solve all cases either.
review.followups: At review completion, UI-025 and UI-026 captured the foreground/fill and selected-popup defects without app changes. The user subsequently selected and accepted their separate fixes. Other accent-ink/focus/slider/About candidates remain UX-003; semantic red/green remains UX-002.
review.verification: Earlier valid native collection has 26 passing probe records; the separate corrected popup collection has six. Final native repeat encountered Windows WinDisc with negative density, so invalid runs are excluded. A full offscreen attempt passes 25 rows and fails SystemDark because that plugin does not implement the system-scheme override. The final explicitly supported offscreen run passes 24 records (Light/Dark plus twenty underlays and setup/cleanup), collecting 46 palette records with resolved colors matching native data. The probe guards invalid density and sampling, and all 61 tracked QML sources/templates pass formatting. No production changes or full-suite/APK rerun claimed.
review.remaining: No remaining work for this accepted review. Original probe/platform limits above describe the review baseline, while the separate fix tickets record later native Android/Windows coverage. UX-002/UX-003 retain their distinct scopes.

resolution.acceptance: 2026-11-06: user tested the updated app and requested: Tested, close ticket and commit changes.
resolution.decision: Keep the intentional A400/A200 accents and lighter Dark primary, all 19 families and System/Light/Dark. Derive foreground/background automatically; do not add four independent color pickers or a Custom mode. Coordinated pair presets are a future convenience, not implemented here.
resolution.report: reviews/UX-001.md preserves the original source/rendered review, official guidance and measurements. Separate UI-025/UI-026 tickets contain actionable contrast defects; UX-002/UX-003 remain deferred.
resolution.remaining: None within the accepted design-review scope.
